title: Oracle acceptance characterization
statement: Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$ be a bit string, and let $r,u$ be natural numbers. The oracle for $N$, queried at index $3$ on the encoding of $x$ paired with the binary encodings of $u$ and $r$, returns true if and only if that encoded string belongs to the acceptance language of $N$.
hypotheses_covered: finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ over Booleans
